L160: The course returns to Python. Version 0.9 taught it in Go; that line is archived on the 【75†`go` branch】 with its v0.9.0 and v0.9.1 releases. A Go 0.10.0 was prepared there on 2026-09-11 but never published, so this release skips that number instead of reusing it. Every URL the Go site served redirects to the matching Python page.
L161: This release is qualified by CI, Docs, Scan, Platform, and a GKE Vertex Gemini smoke, with an explicit Eval waiver: the redesigned model-backed suite exceeds the Eval job's 120-minute CPU-runner budget with `qwen3:4b-instruct`. No model-backed evaluation result is claimed for 0.11.0.
L162: ### 🚀 Features
L163:   * (course) Split the course into laptop Python development and advanced Kubernetes platform engineering, with cumulative exercises and separate completion contracts
L164:   * (workshop) Extend the workshop to eight steps with a prompt-injection guardrail and a learner-owned MCP server; `start N` scaffolds failing stubs and `mise run lab -- status` shows progress and the next command
L165:   * (agent) Make ADK with Gemini the default; retain explicit Ollama profiles, offline checks, and an optional LangGraph/A2A comparison. See 【76†provider migration instructions】
L166:   * (agent) Upgrade to Google ADK 2.10, a2a-sdk 1.1.5, and the OpenAI SDK 3.x
L167:   * (mcp) Move the MCP server to MCP Python SDK 2.x (`MCPServer`), serving revisions 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 with read-only tool annotations
L168:   * (agent) Replace the hand-rolled model fallback with ADK's `FallbackModel`, which fails over only on retriable 429/5xx responses and restores the request between attempts
L169:   * (evals) Introduce MLflow after grader calibration, raise live trajectory acceptance to 80% plus critical cases, and attach feedback to the exact response trace
L170:   * (platform) Add Gemini gateway and local Kubernetes profiles
L171: ### 🐛 Bug Fixes
L172:   * (evals) Accept ADK 2.10's `App`-based evaluation runner while keeping evaluator evidence ahead of the application policy, which the previous adapter rejected before any model call
L173:   * (ci) Smoke the agent image, and start its release-preflight server, on the account-free provider profile, because the Gemini default correctly refuses to start without credentials
L174:   * (ci) Start the Eval judge path on the Ollama gateway profile through the new `gateway:host:ollama:start` task, which the Gemini default refused without a provider key
L175:   * (observability) Align the MLflow server with the 3.16.1 client, and the host Compose image tag with the one `build:mlflow-image` produces
L176: ### 🔒 Security
